How It Works

Set Up Your Business in Simple Steps

Get your store live on OffrO and start reaching local customers, turn on exciting offers and exclusive discounts for them.

01

Join OffrO

Download the app, choose Merchant mode and get started.

02

Create Your Store

Add your business details and set up your digital storefront.

03

Show What You Offer

Add your products, publish banners and highlight your offers.

04

Reach Local Customers

Get discovered by people exploring businesses nearby.

05

Enable Exciting Offers

Share offers and exclusive discounts for customers.
